## R Markdown President's Speeches


```{r}
pdf_text <- pdf_text("data/presidents_speeches.pdf")

presidents_speeches_text <- tibble(page = 1:length(pdf_text), text = pdf_text) %>%
  unnest_tokens(line, text, token = "lines") %>%
  filter(str_squish(line) != "") %>%
  mutate(linenum = row_number())

presidents_speeches_text <- presidents_speeches_text %>%
  mutate(chapter_name = case_when(
    str_detect(line, regex("George W. Bush 1", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "George W. Bush 1",
    str_detect(line, regex("George W. Bush 2", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "George W. Bush 2",
    str_detect(line, regex("Barack H. Obama 1", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Barack H. Obama 1",
    str_detect(line, regex("Barack H. Obama 2", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Barack H. Obama 2",
    str_detect(line, regex("Donald J. Trump 1", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Donald J. Trump 1",
    str_detect(line, regex("Joseph R. Biden 1", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Joseph R. Biden 1",
    str_detect(line, regex("Donald J. Trump 2", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Donald J. Trump 2",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )) %>%
  fill(chapter_name)

presidents_speeches_words <- presidents_speeches_text %>%
  unnest_tokens(word, line)

bing <- get_sentiments("bing")

presidents_speeches_sentiment <- presidents_speeches_words %>%
  inner_join(bing, by = "word") %>%
  count(chapter_name, sentiment) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = sentiment, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) %>%
  mutate(net_sentiment = positive - negative)

speech_order <- c(
  "George W. Bush 1",
  "George W. Bush 2",
  "Barack H. Obama 1",
  "Barack H. Obama 2",
  "Donald J. Trump 1",
  "Joseph R. Biden 1",
  "Donald J. Trump 2"
)

presidents_speeches_sentiment <- presidents_speeches_sentiment %>%
  mutate(chapter_name = factor(chapter_name, levels = speech_order))



ggplot(presidents_speeches_sentiment, aes(x = chapter_name, y = net_sentiment)) +
  geom_col(fill = "darkred") +
  labs(title = "Net Sentiment per President's Speeches",
       x = "Speech", y = "Net Sentiment") +
  theme_minimal()+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

chapter_length <- presidents_speeches_words %>%
  count(chapter_name, name = "total_words")

presidents_speeches_sentiment_normalized <- presidents_speeches_sentiment %>%
  left_join(chapter_length, by = "chapter_name") %>%
  mutate(
    net_sentiment_per_100_words = (net_sentiment / total_words) * 100,
    chapter_name = factor(chapter_name, levels = speech_order)
  )


ggplot(presidents_speeches_sentiment_normalized, aes(x = chapter_name, y = net_sentiment_per_100_words)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  labs(title = "Net Sentiment per 100 Words in President's Speeches",
       x = "Speech", y = "Net Sentiment per 100 Words") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```

## Including Plots


```{r}
nrc <- get_sentiments("nrc")

presidents_speeches_nrc <- presidents_speeches_words %>%
  inner_join(nrc, by = "word")

nrc_summary <- presidents_speeches_nrc %>%
  count(chapter_name, sentiment)

speech_order <- c(
  "George W. Bush 1",
  "George W. Bush 2",
  "Barack H. Obama 1",
  "Barack H. Obama 2",
  "Donald J. Trump 1",
  "Joseph R. Biden 1",
  "Donald J. Trump 2"
)

nrc_summary <- nrc_summary %>%
  mutate(chapter_name = factor(chapter_name, levels = speech_order))

nrc_summary %>%
  filter(sentiment == "fear") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = chapter_name, y = n, group = 1)) +
  geom_line(color = "purple", size = 1.2) +
  labs(title = "Fear Emotion Across President's Speeches",
       x = "Speech", y = "Word Count (Fear)") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

nrc_summary %>%
  filter(sentiment %in% c("joy", "fear", "anger", "sadness")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = chapter_name, y = n, color = sentiment, group = sentiment)) +
  geom_line(size = 1.1) +
  labs(title = "Selected Emotions Across President's Speeches",
       x = "Speech", y = "Count of Emotion Words") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

```
```{r}

nrc_summary_normalized <- nrc_summary %>%
  left_join(chapter_length, by = "chapter_name") %>%
  mutate(freq_per_100 = (n / total_words) * 100,
         chapter_name = factor(chapter_name, levels = speech_order)) 

nrc_summary_normalized %>%
  filter(sentiment == "fear") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = chapter_name, y = freq_per_100, group = 1)) +
  geom_line(color = "purple", size = 1.2) +
  labs(title = "Fear Emotion per 100 Words Across President's Speeches",
       x = "Speech", y = "Fear Words per 100 Words") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

nrc_summary_normalized %>%
  filter(sentiment %in% c("joy", "fear", "anger", "sadness")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = chapter_name, y = freq_per_100, color = sentiment, group = sentiment)) +
  geom_line(size = 1.1) +
  labs(title = "Selected Emotions per 100 Words Across President's Speeches",
       x = "Speech", y = "Emotion Words per 100 Words") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```

```{r}
emotion_counts <- presidents_speeches_nrc %>%
  count(chapter_name, sentiment)

speech_order <- c(
  "George W. Bush 1",
  "George W. Bush 2",
  "Barack H. Obama 1",
  "Barack H. Obama 2",
  "Donald J. Trump 1",
  "Joseph R. Biden 1",
  "Donald J. Trump 2"
)

# Apply the factor levels before plotting
emotion_counts <- presidents_speeches_nrc %>%
  count(chapter_name, sentiment) %>%
  mutate(
    chapter_name = factor(chapter_name, levels = speech_order),
    sentiment = factor(sentiment)  # optional: to control y-axis order
  )

ggplot(emotion_counts, aes(x = chapter_name, y = sentiment, fill = n)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "darkred") +
  labs(title = "Emotion Heatmap Across President's Speeches",
       x = "Speeches", y = "Emotion", fill = "Word Count") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 0.5),
        plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"))
```
```{r}
chapter_length <- presidents_speeches_words %>%
  count(chapter_name, name = "total_words")

emotion_normalized <- emotion_counts %>%
  left_join(chapter_length, by = "chapter_name") %>%
  mutate(freq = n / total_words)

speech_order <- c(
  "George W. Bush 1",
  "George W. Bush 2",
  "Barack H. Obama 1",
  "Barack H. Obama 2",
  "Donald J. Trump 1",
  "Joseph R. Biden 1",
  "Donald J. Trump 2"
)

emotion_normalized <- emotion_normalized %>%
  mutate (chapter_name = factor(chapter_name, levels = speech_order),sentiment = factor(sentiment))

ggplot(emotion_normalized, aes(x = chapter_name, y = sentiment, fill = freq)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "darkred") +
  labs(title = "Normalized Emotion Heatmap Across President's Speeches",
       x = "Speeches", y = "Emotion", fill = "Frequency") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 0.5),
        plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"))
```
```{r}
emotion_normalized <- emotion_normalized %>%
  mutate(freq_pct = freq * 100)

ggplot(emotion_normalized, aes(x = chapter_name, y = sentiment, fill = freq_pct)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "darkred", name = "Emotion %") +
  labs(title = "Normalized per 100 Words Emotion Heatmap Across President's Speeches",
       x = "Speeches", y = "Emotion") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```
```{r}
afinn <- get_sentiments("afinn")

presidents_speeches_afinn <- presidents_speeches_words %>%
  inner_join(afinn, by = "word")

afinn_chapter_sentiment <- presidents_speeches_afinn %>%
  group_by(chapter_name) %>%
  summarise(
    sentiment_score = sum(value),
    word_count = n()
  )

chapter_length <- presidents_speeches_words %>%
  count(chapter_name, name = "total_words")

afinn_chapter_sentiment <- afinn_chapter_sentiment %>%
  left_join(chapter_length, by = "chapter_name") %>%
  mutate(
    sentiment_per_word = sentiment_score / total_words
  )

speech_order <- c(
  "George W. Bush 1",
  "George W. Bush 2",
  "Barack H. Obama 1",
  "Barack H. Obama 2",
  "Donald J. Trump 1",
  "Joseph R. Biden 1",
  "Donald J. Trump 2"
)

afinn_chapter_sentiment <- afinn_chapter_sentiment %>%
  mutate(chapter_name = factor(chapter_name, levels = speech_order))

ggplot(afinn_chapter_sentiment, aes(x = chapter_name, y = sentiment_per_word, group = 1)) +
  geom_line(color = "steelblue", size = 1.2) +
  labs(title = "Normalized AFINN Sentiment Across President's Speeches",
       x = "Speech", y = "Average Sentiment per Word") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

ggplot(afinn_chapter_sentiment, aes(x = chapter_name, y = sentiment_score)) +
  geom_col(fill = "darkgreen") +
  labs(title = "Total AFINN Sentiment Score per President's Speeches",
       x = "Speech",
       y = "Total Sentiment Score") +
  theme_minimal()+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

afinn_chapter_sentiment <- presidents_speeches_afinn %>%
  group_by(chapter_name) %>%
  summarise(sentiment_score = sum(value)) %>%
  left_join(chapter_length, by = "chapter_name") %>%
  mutate(sentiment_per_100_words = (sentiment_score / total_words) * 100)

speech_order <- c(
  "George W. Bush 1",
  "George W. Bush 2",
  "Barack H. Obama 1",
  "Barack H. Obama 2",
  "Donald J. Trump 1",
  "Joseph R. Biden 1",
  "Donald J. Trump 2"
)

afinn_chapter_sentiment <- afinn_chapter_sentiment %>%
  mutate(chapter_name = factor(chapter_name, levels = speech_order))

ggplot(afinn_chapter_sentiment, aes(x = chapter_name, y = sentiment_per_100_words)) +
  geom_col(fill = "darkgreen") +
  labs(title = "AFINN Sentiment per 100 Words per President's Speeches",
       x = "Speech", y = "Sentiment per 100 Words") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```

```{r}
speech_words <- presidents_speeches_words %>%
  anti_join(stop_words, by = "word") %>%
  count(chapter_name, word, sort = TRUE)

top_words <- speech_words %>%
  group_by(chapter_name) %>%
  slice_max(n, n = 10) %>%
  ungroup()

selected_chapters <- c(
  "George W. Bush 1",
  "George W. Bush 2",
  "Barack H. Obama 1",
  "Barack H. Obama 2",
  "Donald J. Trump 1",
  "Joseph R. Biden 1",
  "Donald J. Trump 2"
)

wordcloud_plots <- map(selected_chapters, function(ch_num) {
  chapter_df <- top_words %>% filter(chapter_name == ch_num)

  ggplot(chapter_df, aes(label = word, size = n)) +
    geom_text_wordcloud_area(eccentricity = 1) +
    scale_size_area(max_size = 10) +
    labs(title = paste("", ch_num)) +
    theme_minimal()
})

wrap_plots(wordcloud_plots, ncol = 3) +
  plot_annotation(title = "Top 10 Words per President's Speeches")
```
